objective: Test whether the fixed legacy-120 source subset weakens the query-free teacher without opening any target metric.

diagnosis.mechanism: The streamer itself does not take a prefix. Its exact-120 input contract freezes an upstream deterministic uniform temporal subset and omits otherwise available feature-manifest frames.

scenes.role: deferred scale confirmation after an exact O1/O2 reference authority exists

implementation.composition: Use the sealed legacy-120 exact responsibility plus an exact omitted-only supplement, then retain the global top four by exact marginal mass over the combined manifest-order axis.
implementation.forbidden_shortcut: Do not average independently finalized legacy and supplemental teacher means because each has already discarded non-top-four observations.

execution_order.action: Run the explicit no-supplement all-available control and a matching sealed legacy replay if the prior tensor cache is unavailable.
execution_order.gate: teacher_mean, teacher_valid, retained_view_count and every O1/O2 query_scores tensor must be bitwise equal; artifact-file hashes may differ only because provenance is intentionally different.

execution_order.action: Render omitted-only exact responsibilities in parallel, then materialize each all-available global-top4 teacher and O1/O2 source cache.
execution_order.gate: No frame overlap, exact omitted frame axis, no loss of teacher-valid rows, no decrease in retained-view count for any row, finite normalized descriptors and complete source-only provenance.

execution_order.action: Add an online all-available teacher-agreement/leave-one-source-view-out wrapper reusing the sealed v2 formula, without persisting target-bearing data.
execution_order.gate: Query-free source LOO agreement must not regress on either pilot scene; aggregate gains may not compensate for a per-scene regression.

execution_order.action: Construct and seal the missing exact O1/O2 reference authority, then repeat stages 1 and 2.

promotion_requires: Every affected pilot passes exact composite-axis validation
Every affected pilot passes source-only LOO non-regression
One shared parameter-free all-available policy is used for every scene
promotion_policy.after_promotion: Create a separate one-shot target metric authority under the frozen evaluator; do not modify the evaluator.

basis.scaling_assumption: Projection cost is approximately linear in source-view count; omitted-only responsibility rendering is shorter than full O1/O2 projection.

resource_estimate.thermal_policy: One scene per GPU, 300 W host power limit, external 300 s polling, hard stop only at 88 C; no frequent trigger/pause loop.

cpu_verification.command_scope: all-available domain tests plus frozen legacy streaming and low-memory regression tests
